metaphors.title: Object approaching light speed
metaphors.paraphrase: Not an airplane we fly but something accelerating away from us, receding from sight as it nears light speed.

metaphors.title: Builder and explorer
metaphors.paraphrase: Grothendieck's builder of new houses versus Szegedy's explorer; soon AI does both, and we feel like children again.

metaphors.title: Mathematics as commodity
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematics becomes a commodity produced on demand.

metaphors.title: Go, chess and Move 37
metaphors.paraphrase: Kasparov's and Lee Sedol's confident dismissals; the board for mathematics is infinite.
